children: Lennar reported third-quarter 2026 results with total revenues of $8.05 billion and net earnings attributable to Lennar of $284 million, or $1.19 per diluted share. Adjusting for mark-to-market losses and one-time Financial Services items, adjusted diluted EPS was $1.23. The company highlighted a homebuilding gross margin of 15.8% and homebuilding operating earnings of $502 million.
Total revenues: $8,046,119 thousand for the three months ended August 31, 2026.
Homebuilding gross margin on home sales: $1.2 billion, or 15.8% (third quarter 2026).
Homebuilding operating earnings: $501,962 thousand for the quarter.
Net earnings attributable to Lennar: $283,876 thousand; basic and diluted EPS: $1.19 for the quarter.
Adjusted diluted EPS (excluding $53 million mark-to-market losses and $39 million one-time Financial Services items): $1.23 per diluted share.
Deliveries: 20,840 homes in Q3 2026 (within guidance of 20,500–21,500); average sales price of delivered homes: $372,000.
New orders: 20,879 homes in the quarter; backlog stood at 16,857 homes with a backlog dollar value of $6.3 billion.

Operational efficiency improvements: construction cost per square foot down sequentially, cycle time reached a record low of 116 days, and completed unsold inventory reduced to 1.8 homes per community.

Homebuilding liquidity and capital actions: ended the quarter with $1.15 billion in homebuilding cash and cash equivalents, repurchased 3 million shares for $256 million, and redeemed $400 million of 5.25% senior notes due June 2026.

Segment performance: Financial Services operating earnings of $129 million (includes one-time items net), Multifamily operating loss of $3 million, and Lennar Other operating loss driven by $53 million mark-to-market losses on technology investments.

title: Lennar reports Q3 2026: $8.05B revenue, $284M net, $1.19 EPS
